legal_cultural_warnings.value: Wearing camouflage patterns or military-style gear is strictly illegal for civilians and tourists under national law. Swearing or using profanity in public is considered an offence under the Summary Jurisdiction Act. British Type G and US Type A/B plugs are both used.
legal_cultural_warnings.evidence_quote: It is an offence under the Defence Act to wear camouflage pattern clothing in public

tipping.value: A 10% service charge is usually included on restaurant and hotel bills; leaving an extra 5-10% in cash for staff is standard.
